policy: The original Phase 4 requirement remains blocked unless an alternative tests the same claim and passes the predeclared criteria. A runnable but failing or scientifically narrower substitute is recorded as rejected, never promoted to a pass.

evaluations.original_requirement: A controlled thermal dataset is validated blindly.
evaluations.alternative_name: IEA EBC Annex 71 Twin House component-resolved object-engine diagnostic
evaluations.alternative_scope: The four published N2 air bodies, published component properties and thermal bridges, measured cellar and weather forcing, opening schedules, deterministic graph, and object production adapter are exercised. Post-unsealing corrections are documented under holdout protocol 1.3, so this is diagnostic and not pristine blind validation.
evaluations.rejection_or_limit: The former helper rejection is preserved. The component-resolved replacement fixes boundary, fabric, opening-control, fixed-CET, and RC mass-area mapping defects without residual fitting. It is deterministic and conservative but fails pooled RMSE, bias, per-zone RMSE, and input-completeness gates. The kitchen error remains concentrated around large heat pulses and an open internal door, exposing the reduced one-mass-node and prescribed-opening model forms. Post-unsealing repairs also prevent a blind-validation claim.

evaluations.original_requirement: Integrated performance is tested against NZERTF.
evaluations.alternative_name: Annex 71 measured channels plus DOE BOPTEST and the registered EnergyPlus ideal-load case
evaluations.alternative_scope: The sources were assessed as possible substitutes for integrated temperature, humidity, HVAC, ventilation, occupant-load, and energy evidence.
evaluations.rejection_or_limit: Annex 71 now has a rejected four-air-body production diagnostic, but it does not cover the NZERTF humidity, equipment, occupant-load, and whole-building energy claim; BOPTEST is a simulated control benchmark rather than measured empirical evidence; the EnergyPlus case covers only ideal sensible load accounting.

evaluations.alternative_name: BLS ATUS 2023 weighted respondent-diary population model
evaluations.alternative_scope: Complete survey-weighted development diaries are sampled as correlated schedules and compared with a respondent-isolated holdout for daily sleep, known-location home presence, and sleep-episode duration distributions.
evaluations.rejection_or_limit: The former aggregate-only alternative remains rejected for provenance. The respondent-level replacement passes its predeclared distribution and determinism gates. Its claim is limited to U.S. population schedule priors; it does not establish Italian-household truth or validate condition-dependent action choices.

evaluations.original_requirement: Calibrated parameters succeed on unseen data.
evaluations.alternative_name: Annex 71 coheat/User-1 production parameter transfer diagnostic
evaluations.alternative_scope: The published HTC is allocated from coheat observations and effective capacity is fitted on an early User-1 period before a later-period production-engine diagnostic.
evaluations.test_command: uv run python scripts/validation_data/run_annex71_production_transfer.py; uv run python scripts/validation_data/run_annex71_energy_path_audit.py
evaluations.rejection_or_limit: The production engine is exercised and the known boundary, fabric, opening-control, and RC mapping defects are fixed. The legacy calibration remains bound-seeking, while the component-resolved run still fails frozen error thresholds. The path audit and v4 result reject a single fitted-capacity or conductance explanation. The run is a post-unsealing diagnostic, not unseen-parameter validation.
